name: data-database-merge-request-runtime

evidence.notes: MergeRequest stores and returns the local master record, record ids, and additional-information map.

args: Account master = new Account(Name = 'Master'); Datacloud.AdditionalInformationMap detail = new Datacloud.AdditionalInformationMap(); detail.name = 'Country'; detail.value = 'US'; Database.MergeRequest request = new Database.MergeRequest(); request.setMasterRecord(master); request.setRecordToMergeIds(new List<String>{'001000000000001AAA', '001000000000002AAA'}); request.setAdditionalInformationMap(new List<Datacloud.AdditionalInformationMap>{detail}); System.assertEquals(master, request.getMasterRecord()); System.assertEquals(2, request.getRecordToMergeIds().size()); System.assertEquals('001000000000001AAA', request.getRecordToMergeIds()[0]); System.assertEquals('001000000000002AAA', request.getRecordToMergeIds()[1]); System.assertEquals(1, request.getAdditionalInformationMap().size()); System.assertEquals('Country', request.getAdditionalInformationMap()[0].name); System.assertEquals('US', request.getAdditionalInformationMap()[0].value);

salesforceExclusionReason: Database.MergeRequest is a locally constructible DTO contract; this fixture makes no hosted Salesforce parity claim.
